description:
Search the motion library: polished UI animations and micro-interactions (button presses,
toggles, toasts, number tickers, thinking states, hover effects, interaction sounds) curated
from open-source component libraries and designers' recordings. Each entry has a precise
motion spec (properties, durations, easing curves or spring constants, staggers) and most
have a live demo with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS code.

Use this whenever you build or polish an interactive element and want it to feel finished:
"a satisfying copy button", "toast stack", "AI thinking indicator", "tab underline that slides".
Then call getMotion for the spec, code and a build prompt.

basis.description: Where the numbers come from - code (exact, read from source), video (measured from a recording) or rebuild.

category.description:
Comma-separated categories (OR): button, toggle, input, list, card, navigation, overlay,
toast, loader, text, number, chat-ai, cursor, scroll, transition, icon, feedback, media,
sound, other.

hasCode.description: Only entries with working code (a vanilla rebuild or original source).

source.description: Comma-separated source ids, as listed by getMotionGuidelines.

trigger.description: Comma-separated triggers (OR) - hover, press, click, focus, load, scroll, drag, state-change, loop, type.

name: search_motion

partial.description: True when no entry matched every word.

title: Search UI animations and micro-interactions
